contentText: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang has become the target of a wave of AI-generated misinformation, in a striking twist for one of the men behind the AI revolution. From a fake audio recording supposedly featuring his wife to fabricated LinkedIn profiles, false claims linking him to the Chinese Communist Party and viral AI memes, Vedika Bahl examines how deepfakes and misinformation are turning against the former tech boss in Truth or Fake.
